title: Attachable
description: An attachable definition for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Attachables define how items render when equipped or held by entities, including armor, weapons, tools, and other wearable/holdable items.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this attachable file. Common versions include '1.8.0' and '1.10.0'.

minecraft:attachable.title: Attachable Definition
minecraft:attachable.description:
The attachable definition container.

Properties:
• description ({ identifier, min_engine_version, item, ... })

description.title: Description
description.description:
The attachable description containing all configuration.

Properties:
• identifier (string)
• min_engine_version (int)
• item (string)
• materials
• textures
• geometry
• animations
• scripts ({ parent_setup, pre_animation, scale, ... })
• ... and 5 more properties

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The unique identifier for this attachable. Should match the item identifier it attaches to (e.g., 'minecraft:iron_chestplate').

min_engine_version.title: Minimum Engine Version
min_engine_version.description: The minimum engine version required for this attachable.

item.title: Item
item.description: The item identifier this attachable is associated with. If not specified, uses the attachable identifier.

materials.title: Materials
materials.description:
Material definitions for rendering the attachable. Keys are material names (e.g., 'default', 'enchanted'), values are material identifiers.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

textures.title: Textures
textures.description:
Texture definitions for the attachable. Keys are texture names (e.g., 'default', 'enchanted'), values are texture paths.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

[a-zA-Z0-9_]+.title: Texture Path
[a-zA-Z0-9_]+.description: A texture path relative to the resource pack (e.g., 'textures/models/armor/iron_1').

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description:
Geometry definitions for the attachable. Keys are geometry names (e.g., 'default'), values are geometry identifiers.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

animations.title: Animations
animations.description:
Animation and animation controller definitions. Keys are short names used in scripts, values are full animation/controller identifiers.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

[a-zA-Z0-9_]+.title: Animation Identifier
[a-zA-Z0-9_]+.description: An animation or animation controller identifier (e.g., 'animation.elytra.gliding', 'controller.animation.elytra.default').

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description:
Script definitions for the attachable, including initialization and animation triggers.

Properties:
• parent_setup
• pre_animation
• scale
• animate
• should_update_bones_and_effects_offscreen (boolean)
• should_update_effects_offscreen (boolean)

parent_setup.title: Parent Setup
parent_setup.description: Molang script executed when the attachable is set up on the parent entity. Used to set variables like 'variable.chest_layer_visible = 0.0;'.

pre_animation.title: Pre-Animation
pre_animation.description: Molang script executed before animations are processed.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Molang expression for the scale of the attachable.

animation_name.title: Animation Name
animation_name.description: Short name of an animation defined in the animations section.

anyOf.title: Animate (Array)
anyOf.description: Array of animation names to play.

animate.title: Animate
animate.description:
List of animations to play. Can be animation short names or objects with conditional playback.

Properties:
• animation_name (string)

should_update_bones_and_effects_offscree.title: Should Update Bones And Effects Offscreen
should_update_bones_and_effects_offscree.description: Whether bones and effects should be updated when the entity is offscreen.

should_update_effects_offscreen.title: Should Update Effects Offscreen
should_update_effects_offscreen.description: Whether effects should be updated when the entity is offscreen.

defaultSnippets.label: Scripts
defaultSnippets.description: Script definitions for the attachable, including initialization and animation triggers.

render_controllers.title: Render Controllers
render_controllers.description: List of render controller identifiers or conditional render controllers.

enable_attachables.title: Enable Attachables
enable_attachables.description: Whether to allow child attachables on this attachable.

particle_effects.title: Particle Effects
particle_effects.description:
Particle effect definitions for the attachable.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

sound_effects.title: Sound Effects
sound_effects.description:
Sound effect definitions for the attachable.

Properties:
• [a-zA-Z0-9_]+ (string)

spawn_egg.title: Spawn Egg
spawn_egg.description:
Spawn egg configuration for this attachable, if applicable.

Properties:
• texture (string)
• texture_index (int)

texture.title: Texture
texture.description: Texture path for the spawn egg.

texture_index.title: Texture Index
texture_index.description: Index into the spawn egg texture atlas.

defaultSnippets.label: Spawn Egg
defaultSnippets.description: Spawn egg configuration for this attachable, if applicable.
